versions.changelog: Switch OpenAPI requests to openapi.codia.ai, add async image-to-design support, and refresh the public skills bundle.

- Updated description to clarify support for images, design resources, and visual assets.
- Incremented version to 0.1.3.
- No changes to logic, functionality, or routing—documentation/metadata update only.

- Updated the description in SKILL.md for improved clarity on supported tasks and user intents.
- Raised version to 0.1.2. 
- No logic or functionality changes were made; update is documentation only.

- Introduced initial router skill for Codia Design Skills covering CLI setup, authentication, and routing to feature/workflow modules.
- Added clear instructions for installing, authenticating, and verifying the `codia-design` CLI on macOS/Linux and Windows.
- Defined routing rules for various design, conversion, image, PDF, and vectorization tasks, pointing to respective subskills.
- Clarified usage of local file paths, download options, CLI flags, cost/credits checking commands, and safe handling of sensitive information.
- Outlined preference logic for workflow vs. feature skills based on user intent.
- Provided concrete output and result reporting guidelines.
